developers.gateSubtitle: Technical settings for the learning engine.
developers.resetLinkHint: Wipes XP, challenges, trophies and Weekly Times Tables for a chosen child

developers.whatsappTestFailed: Could not send. Check the number and the connection.
developers.opsAlertsHint: Email sent when the WhatsApp infrastructure fails — server down, session disconnected, or real sends failing even though the connection looks fine.
developers.opsAlertsWhatsappHint: Alerts when the WhatsApp session drops or reconnects (Evolution API event).
developers.opsAlertsRailwayHint: Alerts when the Evolution API server on Railway stops responding.
developers.opsAlertsSendFailureHint: Alerts when real sends fail even though the status says 'connected' — catches the case where the status is lying.
developers.opsAlertsWebhookHint: Alerts if our Evolution API event receiver stops accepting requests — without this, the 'WhatsApp disconnected' alert above goes blind.
